banners.title: Banners
banners.subtitle: The pictures at the top of the customer app: where each one goes, when it shows and at which outlets.
banners.emptyDescription: Add a banner to promote a service, an outlet or a page of the app.

schedule.sentenceAlways: No schedule: once it is active, it shows right away and keeps showing until you turn it off.
schedule.sentenceFrom: Shows from {{start}} ({{zone}}) and keeps showing until you turn it off.
schedule.sentenceUntil: Shows right away and stops at {{end}} ({{zone}}).

detail.title: Banner
detail.subtitle: How this banner looks and behaves in the customer app.

order.title: Arrange banners
order.subtitle: Drag the banners into the order the carousel shows them in. The first one is seen first.
order.hint: Drag a banner by its handle, or use the arrows. Nothing changes in the app until you save.
order.unsaved: The new order is not saved yet.
order.drag: Move {{name}} (drag, or press space and use the arrow keys)
order.instructions: Press space to pick up a banner, the arrow keys to move it, space to drop it and escape to cancel.

form.createSubtitle: A picture for the top of the customer app, with a place to send people to.
form.editSubtitle: Change the picture, where it goes, or when it shows.
form.title: Title
form.internalNotesHint: Only the team sees this, never customers.
form.notesPlaceholder: Example: Weekend promo, agreed with marketing on 25 Oct.
form.imageDescription: The picture customers see. It is cropped to fit, so keep the important part in the middle.
form.dropRules: JPG, PNG, WebP or AVIF, up to {{mb}} MB. Ratio {{ratio}}.
form.uploadFailed: The picture could not be uploaded. Try again.
form.imageNeededToActivate: A banner needs a picture before it can be active.
form.targetDescription: What opens in the app when a customer taps the banner.
form.targetNoneNote: Tapping does nothing: the banner is only a picture.

targetDescriptions.screen: Opens a page of the app

form.externalHint: A full address starting with https://. It opens in the browser.
form.externalInvalid: Enter a full web address starting with https://.
form.deeplinkHint: Worked out from the target. Copy it to use the same link elsewhere.
form.deeplinkEmpty: No link: pick a target first.
form.scheduleDescription: Both are optional and use your browser's time zone ({{zone}}). Leave one empty to leave that end open.
form.startsAtHint: Empty: shows as soon as it is active.
form.endsAtHint: Empty: keeps showing until you turn it off.
form.endBeforeStart: The end must be after the start.
form.outletsDescription: Which outlets' customers see this banner.
form.scopeAllDescription: Every customer sees it, wherever they order.
form.scopeSomeDescription: Only customers of the outlets you pick.
form.outletsRequired: Pick at least one outlet, or choose all outlets.
form.statusActiveDescription: Published: it shows whenever its schedule allows.
form.statusInactiveDescription: Kept as a draft: never shown.
